news.title: Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sink on OpenAI revenue report
news.description: OpenAI has told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed.

news.title: U.S. suspends Microsoft, Adobe from green card labor program in foreign worker crackdown
news.description: Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling cited "multiple active federal investigations" around the two companies' involvement in the program Thursday.

news.title: Why a Starbucks takeover of Chipotle would — and wouldn't — make sense for both companies
news.description: Starbucks has reportedly been working with advisers on a takeover proposal for Chipotle, but a potential deal comes with pros and cons for investors.
